title: Effects of Legume Intake on Cardiovascular Risk Factors Among Adults at Risk for Diabetes
brief_summary: This randomized cross-over study was designed to investigate the effects of legume enriched diet consumption on cardiovascular risk factors among first degree relatives of diabetic patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* subjects aged more than 30 years
* no history of chronic diseases
* no use of blood glucose lowering drugs be wiling to participate to study

Exclusion Criteria:

* do not follow study protocol
* incidence of chronic diseases during the study
* to start use of blood glucose lowering drugs or to change dose and type of current medications
